articles.text: MǍDĪNG XIĀNSHENG: Wèi, nǐ shi Zhū Kēzhǎng ma?
MR. MARTIN: Hello. Are you Section Chief Zhū?
ZHŪ KĒZHǍNG: Shì. Nín shi něiwèi?
SECTION CHIEF ZHŪ: Yes. Who is this, please?
MǍDĪNG XIĀNSHENG: Wǒ shi Mǎdīng. Wǒ yǒu diǎnr shì xiǎng gēn nín dāngmiàn tántan.
MR. MARTIN: I'm Martin. I have something I'd like to talk with you about in person.
ZHŪ KĒZHǍNG: Hǎo. Shénme shíhou duì nín héshì?
SECTION CHIEF ZHŪ: Fine. What time would suit you?
MǍDĪNG XIĀNSHENG: Jīntian xiàwǔ liǎngdiǎn zhōng fāngbian ma?
MR. MARTIN: Would two o'clock this afternoon be convenient?
ZHŪ KĒZHǍNG: Sāndiǎn bǐ liǎngdiǎn fāngbian yìdiǎnr.
SECTION CHIEF ZHŪ: Three would be a little more convenient than two.
MR. MARTIN: Fine. I'll see you at three.
